correctness.rationale: The exact standard-library verifier reconstructs the Fano incidence graph, exhausts all graph homomorphisms to C5, obtains 3300 vertices and the complete 11340-edge recoloring graph, proves connectivity, computes diameter and radius 35 by BFS from every vertex, and verifies that the published component-orientation criterion is acyclic for an explicit representative. Theorem 5.1 of arXiv:2408.04802 then gives the circle homotopy type of the unique component.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical cubic 6-cage and Fano-plane Levi graph, and C5 is the smallest non-complete odd cycle target. The Hom complex simultaneously records topology and recoloring connectivity. The exact conclusion that all 3300 colorings form one essential circle component, with diameter 35, is a natural reproducible benchmark and is not a routine corollary of the component-classification theorem.
